  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds, making Card the only adverse family. Account access, Velocity and Linkage conditions do not hold; no household exception is needed. No Context rule holds: the first-attempt amount is below the category p95 threshold. No earlier outcome settles the order. Under §6.6(b), id_check was the required verification, and it passed; §5.3(a) therefore requires clear and prohibits further hold or adverse action. A legitimate new customer using a foreign-issued card is the strongest benign explanation. No installment was due, so non-payment cannot support a determination. No further check is needed."
